properties.displayName: UAV Campaign C6 - Maintenance Implant → Firmware Tamper → SAR Target Exfil
properties.description: 정비임플란트(S21, HashMatch==0 SByte) → 펌웨어 재확인(S4) → SAR 허가구역 외 유출(S17, AreaRadiusM meter단위). 연결키: UAVId. 실제 컬럼: MissionId 없음→UAVId, AreaRadiusM(meter). MITRE: T1195, T1020
properties.query:
let windowSize = 24h;
// S21: 정비 임플란트
let S21 =
    UAVMaintenance_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where EventType == 'component_replace'
    | join kind=inner (
        UAVPgse_CL
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
        | where HashMatch == 0
        | project T_pgse=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId)
    ) on UAVId
    | where T_pgse >= TimeGenerated and T_pgse <= TimeGenerated + 30m
    | project T1=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId), ComponentName, Operator;
// S4: 펌웨어 해시 재확인
let S4 =
    UAVPgse_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where HashMatch == 0
    | project T2=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId);
// S17: SAR 허가구역 외 유출 (AreaRadiusM = meter)
let AuthArea = UAVC4I_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AreaLat, AreaLon, AreaRadiusM) by UAVId=Callsign;
let S17 =
    UAVSarPayload_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | join kind=leftouter (AuthArea) on UAVId
    | extend distM = geo_distance_2points(
        toreal(TargetLon), toreal(TargetLat),
        toreal(AreaLon), toreal(AreaLat))
    | where distM > toreal(AreaRadiusM)
    | project T3=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId), distM;
S21
| join kind=inner (S4) on UAVId
| where T2 >= T1
| join kind=inner (S17) on UAVId
| where T3 >= T2
| extend CampaignType = "C6_정비임플란트_펌웨어변조_SAR표적유출"
| extend StepSummary = strcat("S21@", tostring(T1), "(", ComponentName, ")→S4@", tostring(T2), "→S17@", tostring(T3), "(", tostring(toint(distM)), "m)")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project T1, T2, T3, UAVId, ComponentName, Operator, distM, CampaignType, StepSummary, Severity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [CAMPAIGN] UAV Campaign C6 - Maintenance Implant → Firmware Tamper → SAR Target Exfil - {{Operator}}
